purpose: Test whether frozen stem/foot versus closed pointed-contour criteria survive cross-card variation before attempting the disputed card330 slot. No new literal or key change.
criteria_basis: Existing frozen atlas descriptions of G05/G19; class mapping/literals withheld from coded observer. Earlier unblinded readings and atlas examples were available to planner; not globally blind or novel source material.

features.F0: Target ink separable enough from neighbors to attribute the features; yes/no/unclear. No interpretation if no or unclear.
features.F1: Distinct oblique stem extending upward outside the low contour/foot; yes/no/unclear.
features.F2: Separate short baseline foot or low hook attached to that stem; yes/no/unclear.
features.F3: Closed pointed/triangular leaf-like contour; yes/no/unclear. Require visible closure, do not infer from spelling.

decision_rules.L: F0=yes,F1=no,F3=yes; F2 must not be a distinct attached stem foot
decision_rules.N: Any other combination or unclear feature. Abstention is mandatory; no nearest-class rule.

selection.canonical_controls: Both frozen G05 examples and both frozen G19 examples in card199 atlas; do not replace failed controls.
selection.negative_controls: Both frozen G11 examples, expected N rather than binary forced match.
selection.transfer_tests: First two card328 ledger rows containing G05, and first row containing G19, in saved line/word order; exact designated body indices selected from class sequence. No selection by readable plaintext or later feature outcome.
selection.disputed_target: Card330 L01W03B05, previously retained R_L01W03B05; no A003 loop or written-date input.
selection.coded_order: Collector deterministic shuffle seed330328; observer sees coded target windows only, no expected roles/classes/literals.

stop_rule: All four canonical controls must meet expected S/L and both negative controls N. Then all three transfer tests must match their saved provisional family criteria. If any fail or abstain, stop transfer/adjudication; retain card330 mask irrespective of its isolated observation. No feature tuning, replacement examples, thresholds or repeated crops after scoring.
image_method: Original provider bytes already available locally; crop, exact quarter turn where recorded, ordinary nearest-neighbor resizing only. No enhancement, thresholding, watermark removal or pixel publication. Coordinates and hashes published as text.
limitations: Controls are frozen proposed class examples, not external ground truth.
Small purposive sample, dependent handwriting observations, no probability/accuracy estimate.
Coded observer is an AI with generic prior knowledge; label concealment is procedural, not certified blindness.
Only written-cipher class shape transfer assessed; no itinerary, date, identity or full decipherment.
